title: AI Memory Market Boom: SK Hynix $720B Investment #shorts
description: The AI economy is surging, with SK Hynix announcing a $720 billion investment in memory factories. High Bandwidth Memory is crucial for AI chips, controlling 58% of the market. DRAM prices are set to soar 400% by year-end. #AIeconomy #SKhynix #MemoryMarket #TechInvestment #HighBandwidthMemory
